title: Black Friday 2025 public campaign
description: Public Black Friday promotion running Friday to Sunday. The promotion was online-only and offered 20% off eligible silver products, excluding eye rings, mixed-metal products, enamel products and collaborations. Physical stores did not participate; POS was still operated through Square. A mailing-list VIP preview took place on 27 November 2025 before public access began.

title: Black Friday 2025 VIP early access
description: VIP early access for mailing-list customers. Customers on the mailing list received access one day before the public Black Friday promotion. The promotion was online-only and offered 20% off eligible silver products, excluding eye rings, mixed-metal products, enamel products and collaborations. Physical stores did not participate; POS was still operated through Square.

title: TGF East Black Friday Sale 2024
description: TGF East sale hours: 9 November 2024, 10:30 AM–6:30 PM. Applicable campaign discounts: 20% off 925 sterling silver; 15% off eye jewellery; 20% off music collaborations; 10% off enamel and stone rings; and 20% off clothing. Exclusions: gold, wedding, other collaboration pieces and collaboration clothing, leather goods, selected newly released items, and selected earrings.

title: Online Black Friday Sale 2024
description: Online sale ran from 8 November 2024 at 8:00 AM GMT through 10 November 2024 at midnight GMT. Discounts: 20% off 925 sterling silver; 15% off eye jewellery; 20% off music collaborations; 10% off enamel and stone rings; and 20% off clothing. Exclusions: gold, wedding, other collaboration pieces and collaboration clothing, leather goods, selected newly released items, and selected earrings.

title: Black Friday Sale 2024
description: Black Friday sale offering discounts on almost everything. Campaign dates: 7–10 November 2024. Promoted as the biggest Black Friday sale yet. The promotion noted that Sunday 10 November 2024 was the last order date for Christmas gifts involving made-to-order jewellery.

title: TGF Soho Black Friday Sale 2024
